professionalSummary: Project manager in the claims change team of a general insurer for three years, running five claims automation projects under the insurer's delivery framework with their plans and budget tracking. (src_a4700dc792f8)
experienceHighlights: Prepared the monthly steering committee report for each project, with the reports and the committee's decisions filed in the programme office's repository. (src_aaf41be37b1e)
Managed the dependencies with the claims platform team and claims operations through the framework's dependency log, escalating three platform slips to the programme board. (src_a33bb990ee74)

Took scope change requests to the programme board with the impact assessment, recording in each request which analysis was mine and which came from the platform team; the scope decisions were the board's. (src_209d7f6b2973)
Wrote the closure reports for the four completed projects with the project boundary statement and the benefits evidence accepted by finance. (src_484d370218cb)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: one project plan with its budget tracker, one steering committee report, one scope change request with the board decision and one closure report, with the programme office repository references as a verification trail. (src_d92721cdc57d)
